start.title: Blue Light in the Cut
start.text: A fracture in the hillside exposes a narrow cave glazed with blue ice. Sunlight caught in the walls makes the interior glow even though the entrance faces away from the sky.

buckets.flavourText: The floor is stable, but a line of fresh scratches shows something heavy was dragged deeper inside.
The first chamber looks sound enough. Beyond it, the ice hides the floor.
The beauty of the ice is more obvious than its hazards.

inside_alert.title: Scratches Under Glass
inside_alert.text: The scratches continue to a pocket where the ice has formed around an old wooden chest. The lid is visible; the rest is frozen solid.

choices.text: Free the chest without cracking the shelf

buckets.flavourText: You lever it loose in one piece. Inside are moulded blankets, a rusted knife, and a sealed tin of tea.
The chest comes free as the shelf cracks. You save the tin before meltwater takes the rest.
The shelf fractures and the chest slides into a blue fissure too narrow to follow.

choices.text: Leave the chest where it is

inside.title: Glass Walls
inside.text: The cave narrows until your shoulders nearly touch both sides. Every breath returns in delayed whispers. Ahead, something wooden is trapped in the ice.

cache.title: Old Winter Stores
cache.text: The tea tin is stamped with a merchant mark you have not seen in the hub. The cache may be decades old, but the seal still holds.

small_cache.title: One Thing Saved
small_cache.text: The tin is dented but intact. Behind you, water begins ticking into the fissure one drop at a time.

lost.title: Taken by the Crack
lost.text: The chest disappears below the ice with a hollow knock. The cave suddenly feels much deeper than it looked from outside.

leave.title: Blue Light Behind You
leave.text: You leave the cave to keep its secrets. The blue light remains visible through the trees until the slope turns.
